rows: all = valid particles; predicted = all minus rigid actuators and fixtures; moving = predicted rows that leave their last context position by 5.0 mm or more within the scored frames
numbers: mm; zero = predict no motion, hold = hold the last context velocity; mean over scored frames and rows of one clip (the per-clip averaging of TrajectoryScores), _final = at the last scored frame; motion_mm_per_frame = mean step of the predicted rows over the scored transitions

windows.selection: one window per test episode in the loader's stratified order, start drawn from the episode id (IndexedEpisodeDataset._draw_starts)
windows.evaluator: eval_unified.py --clips all (the loader's own order, no row sets), or eval_unified.py --cases <this manifest> --case_set windows --clips all

windows_motion.selection: four windows per episode at the within-episode quantiles [0.125, 0.375, 0.625, 0.875] of the window's mean predicted step (ties: earliest start)

rollouts_first.selection: the first 236 episodes of the stratified order, from frame 0 for 128 frames (capped by the episode)
rollouts_first.evaluator: eval_unified.py --rollout --rollout_frames 128 --clips all (the loader's own order, no row sets), or eval_unified.py --cases <this manifest> --case_set rollouts_first --rollout --rollout_frames 128 --clips all

rollouts_active.selection: the same episodes from the start whose scored frames carry the most predicted motion (ties: earliest start)
